title: fix(sim): judge a tool body by the band stack the simulation draws
body:
Retargeted to `main`; was stacked on #837. `origin/main` merged in (ed8616b4; conflict in `operation/mod.rs` resolved by keeping both `body_judged` and `fixture_route`). Today's main (fixture routing #489, holder libraries, plasma/swing laws) adds no new `Cutter` literal or cylinder reader: `fixture_route` sweeps `verify::steel_stack` (already the band stack), `posting_index_swing` reads the total length (equal for both shapes).

## What changed
A tool with a modelled body (#368 mesh, #93 drawn spun holder) is now judged by **one** shape: the band stack the fixture laws sweep and the simulation draws (`tool_body::stack`), not the single cylinder enclosing it (option 1, decided by the orchestrating session; `docs/decisions/835-reach-reads-band-stack.md`).

- `sim::verify::BodyBands` (new, `body_bands.rs`): the body's bands above the shank, fixed capacity (33) so `Cutter` stays `Copy`. Refused back to the cylinder (`None`) when the stack is the plain holder cylinder (no body, no change), non-finite, starts in the flutes, reaches past the enclosing holder/shank, or tops out elsewhere. `Cutter::judged` re-checks it against the geometry the laws read.
- `Cutter::body` + `Cutter::with_body` / `holder_bands`: `atoms()` emits the body's bands in place of the holder band.
- `reach.rs`: law (c) and (c3) read `Cutter::judged(cx.tool, cx.cutter).holder_bands()`. Law (c) convicts a move once per group (shank, then holder-or-bands), worst offender first - a no-body tool's output is identical (one band per group).
- `operation::generate`: one cutter `Cutter::of(&tool).with_body(&geom, &holder)` feeds both `VerifyContext.cutter` sites, `contain_into` and `rotary_into`.

## Which laws moved / kept
- **Moved to the band stack:** (c) shank/holder reach, (c3) mid-turn sweep, (b2) solid law, the containment kinds' solid law, posed rapids (via the judged cutter), the rotary field law. Fixture laws (c2/d2, mesh) already read it. (e) cycle reach reads the total length, which is equal for both shapes.
- **Kept the enclosing cylinder, named:** drill-reach axial holder and cross-drill holder refusals, cross-drill `part_clear`, probe stylus reach. A refusal naming the holder of a tool with a body gains "the tool body is judged here by the cylinder enclosing it, Ø... mm to ... mm above the tip" (`operation::body_judged::name_enclosure`, applied in `run_job`); a probe path with a body carries the same words as a note. Moving them: **#842** (filed).
- **Unchanged, not shape verdicts:** magazine fit (widest diameter is the right reading), 5-axis shank-avoid dodge (generator choice), posed-contact (f2) shank excuse.


## Review round 2 (head f74f878d)
- **Contiguity is checked** (finding 2): `BodyBands::of` returns `None` (the enclosing cylinder stands) for a stack that is not contiguous from the shank's top - a gap, a late first band, or an overlap. Pinned: `tool_body_bands::a_gapped_stack_is_refused_and_the_cylinder_stands`, `a_late_starting_stack_is_refused_and_the_cylinder_stands`.
- **Raised foot, direction stated** (finding 3): when a body's foot stands above the shank's top, the gap is judged at the **shank's radius** (the shank carried up, as the fixture laws have since #368), where the cylinder judged it at the enclosing holder's. That is **looser where the body is wider than the shank, stricter where the shank is wider**. Both sides pinned: `tool_body_bands::a_raised_foot_over_a_slim_shank_is_judged_looser_than_the_cylinder` (cylinder: ShankHit, bands: clean; body in the wall still ShankHit), `a_raised_foot_over_a_fat_shank_is_judged_stricter_than_the_cylinder` (holder group now convicts too). Kept on the shank radius because nothing modelled is wider there: the body's envelope starts at its own lowest vertex, and with a body the record's holder is replaced by the body - the only steel in the gap is the shank (reasoning in the decisions file).
- **(c3) behind (c)** (review note): a stock-only `ShankHit` used to stand down the mid-turn sweep on that move and could hide a swing through the PART (both block the post, but the user was told "uncut stock"). Now (c3) is skipped only where (c) already named the part; on a stock-only conviction it runs and a part `SweepHit` is reported (a stock sweep there is dropped as the same event). Applies to tools without a body too (can only add a part warning). Pinned: `tool_body_bands::a_swing_through_the_part_is_not_hidden_behind_a_stock_shank_hit` (fails on the old code: only `ShankHit{part:false}`).
- **Gated on the merged tree** (f74f878d, `--base origin/main`): quick gate sim/motion/app/ui all ok (45.7 min); app `verify`, `tool_spun_profile`, `tool_body_view` ok; clippy -D warnings on sim, app, motion clean.

## Readings, stepped body (Ø8 end mill; r6 nose 14..34 above tip, r20 flange 34..49; enclosing cylinder r20 from 14 to 49)
| case | before (cylinder) | after (bands) |
|---|---|---|
| wall 10 mm off axis, tip 30 deep (flange 4 mm above stock top) | `ShankHit{at:1, part:true}` | none |
| wall 10 mm off, tip 40 deep (flange 6 mm into wall) | ShankHit | ShankHit (still) |
| wall 5 mm off, tip 30 deep (nose in wall) | ShankHit | ShankHit (still, once) |

## Pinning tests (`crates/app/tests/tool_body_judged.rs`)
- `the_band_stack_is_never_smaller_than_an_imported_mesh_body` - samples a faceted, turned, lifted mesh (nose, cone, flange, taper): envelope, swept stack and the reach laws' stack all >= the body's radius at every sample.
- `the_band_stack_is_never_smaller_than_a_drawn_profile_with_cones_and_arcs` - same against the drawn outline (line, cone, convex arc, concave arc) sampled on its true circles.
- `a_stepped_nose_clear_of_the_wall_is_no_longer_warned`, `a_band_that_reaches_the_wall_is_still_warned`, `a_tool_with_no_body_reads_unchanged`
- `a_stack_that_is_not_this_tools_is_refused_and_the_cylinder_stands`
- `the_simulation_draws_the_stack_the_reach_laws_judge` - `sim_tool_body::for_operation` holder bands == judged cutter's bands == fixture stack.
- `a_law_that_keeps_the_cylinder_names_it`
- plus the five round-2 tests in `crates/app/tests/tool_body_bands.rs` (above)

## How tested
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/issue/743-sim-revolved-tool-body`: motion, app (incl. tool_body_judged, probe_reach, rotary_verify, solid_law, drill_reach, ...), ui green; sim step failed to compile on first run (two sim test `Cutter` literals missed `body: None`), fixed and the same sim suite list re-run green (16 binaries).
- By name: app `verify`, `tool_spun_profile`, `sim_tool_body`, `tool_body`, `tool_body_view`, `tool_body_judged` green.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

## Goldens moved
None. No golden, snapshot or existing assertion changed; test edits are only `body: None` in `Cutter` literals (motion `solid_law`, sim `midmove_pose`, `overhang_laws`).

## Not exercised
- Release tier / `--ignored` heavy lanes (incl. sim/app envelope lanes) not run.
- A leaning (posed) body through (c)/(c3) is not pinned on its own (same per-band code path).
- No end-to-end generated op with a body against a part wall (pinned at the verify level plus the world-level drawn==judged check); posed/leaning bodies through (c)/(c3) and the rotary law with a body not separately pinned (same per-band code paths).
- GUI not launched.

Changelog: A tool body (imported or drawn) is judged by the same band stack the simulation draws by the reach, sweep, solid and rotary laws - a stepped holder whose flange stands clear is no longer warned; laws that still use the enclosing cylinder say so; a mid-turn swing through the part is no longer hidden behind a stock shank warning on the same move (#835)

Effort: high (no escalation)

Fixes #835
